feature-importance.pseudocode:
def permutation_importance(model, X, y, score, repeats=5):
    base = score(y, model.predict(X))  # 기준 성능
    imp = []
    for j in range(len(X[0])):
        drops = []
        for _ in range(repeats):
            Xp = [row[:] for row in X]
            col = [row[j] for row in Xp]
            shuffle(col)  # 변수 j와 타깃의 관계만 끊음
            for row, v in zip(Xp, col):
                row[j] = v
            drops.append(base - score(y, model.predict(Xp)))
        imp.append(sum(drops) / repeats)  # 평균 성능 하락
    return imp

federated-averaging.pseudocode:
def fed_avg(w, clients, rounds, C=0.1, E=5, B=32, lr=0.01):
    for t in range(rounds):
        m = max(1, int(C * len(clients)))
        selected = sample(clients, m)  # 참여 클라이언트
        updates, sizes = [], []
        for c in selected:
            wk = copy(w)
            for _ in range(E):  # 로컬 E 에폭 학습
                for batch in c.batches(B):
                    wk = wk - lr * grad(wk, batch)
            updates.append(wk)  # 원본 데이터는 전송 안 함
            sizes.append(c.n)
        n = sum(sizes)
        # 데이터 수에 비례한 가중 평균으로 집계
        w = sum(nk / n * wk
                for nk, wk in zip(sizes, updates))
    return w

federated-learning.pseudocode:
def fedavg(global_w, clients, rounds, local_train):
    for _ in range(rounds):
        updates, sizes = [], []
        for c in clients:  # 원본 데이터는 단말에 유지
            w = local_train(global_w, c.data)
            updates.append(w)
            sizes.append(len(c.data))
        total = sum(sizes)
        # 데이터 수 기준 가중 평균
        global_w = [
            sum(u[i] * n for u, n in zip(updates, sizes))
            / total
            for i in range(len(global_w))
        ]
    return global_w
